# /crav1-complete-features

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: reference only · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-complete-features/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Serial board: build several ready specs one slug after another in this checkout.

Serial board of ready slugs: `feat/<slug>` from default, then that spec’s complete-tasks loop; no parallel, no push, no PR.

## Runs when

Several specs, one after another. Called by the user.

## Reads

In short: Ready spec folders on the default branch.

Reads ready spec folders already on the default branch.

## Writes

In short: The commit-style rule once, and a `feat/<slug>` checkout; one worker per `T#` writes that task's code, `tasks.md`, `verify.md`, `fix-log.md` when a fix runs, and the commits.

Writes the commit-style rule once when it is missing, and a `feat/<slug>` checkout from default per slug.

## Does not

Leaves product code, commits, `spec.md`, push, and the pull request alone in this chat.

Limits and exceptions: one ready slug stops and points at [`/crav1-complete-tasks`](crav1-complete-tasks.md) without running it. When a slice is marked done or retired, it asks once whether to run [`/crav1-keep-current`](crav1-keep-current.md) and does not run it.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-open-pr`](crav1-open-pr.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls [`/crav1-feature-branch`](crav1-feature-branch.md) for that checkout, without re-prompting, and `crav1-complete-task-agent` one `T#` at a time.

Lane: Build. Group: Build. Starter option: no. Routing: [guild routing](../../guild-routing.md).
